trailhead.label: Pradèt car park above Grumes, the APT’s start

cautions: A mountain path (480) with roots and stones, and forest roads used by occasional forestry vehicles.
A steady climb of about 300 m.
A stream beside the path: keep your dog out of it after heavy rain.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
